Purchase Order

The Purchase Order view displays comprehensive details about a specific purchase order, including supplier information, line items, quantities, prices, and totals.

This view provides a formatted presentation of the purchase order that matches how it will appear when printed or emailed to your supplier.

Available Actions

From this view, you can perform several actions:

• Edit - Modify the purchase order details by clicking the Edit button

• Print - Generate a PDF version for printing or saving

• Email - Send the purchase order directly to the supplier's email address

• Copy to - Create new transactions based on this purchase order

The view automatically displays all relevant information including issue date, reference number, supplier details, line items with quantities and prices, applicable taxes, and the total amount.

To learn about creating and editing purchase orders, see: Purchase Order — Edit
